feeding_claim.verbatim: Our certified-organic herd of Jersey cows is 100% grass-fed.

certifications.evidence_note: Matched to USDA record "Misty Brook Farm" (Albion, ME), livestock certified, in the Organic Integrity snapshot of 2026-10-01.

resold_note: The farm store also sells raw sheep milk from Golden Fleece Farm, kefir from Milkhouse, vegetables from Ironwood Farm, salami from Small Good and other goods from Maine producers.
notes: Verifier 2026-11-22: products, raw dairy and farm store pages checked. Verbatim quote confirmed on the raw dairy page. Farm store lists Organic 100% Grass-Fed Beef and Lamb and pastured soy-free pork, no finishing statement, so category stays grass-fed. Store open daily dawn to dusk, self-serve. Farm sells its own raw milk, half and half and cream; kefir and yogurt are Milkhouse products. Farm store page says the farm does not ship. Raw milk sales are legal only in some states.
